svg.title: Solar prominence — Sólstrókur
svg.desc: A tall loop of plasma arches away from the curved solar limb, with a separate short surface contour below it.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Sectors and Nature","subject":"space-solar-prominence","label_en":"Solar prominence","label_is":"Sólstrókur","section":"16","category_en":"Space, astronomy and exploration","category_is":"Geimurinn, stjörnufræði og geimrannsóknir","batch":8,"tags":["space","solar-phenomenon"],"description":"A tall loop of plasma arches away from the curved solar limb, with a separate short surface contour below it.","design_note":"The loop is labelled a solar prominence, following NASA terminology, rather than treating every solar loop as a flare.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
